_source: Data/Raw/Survey (with WeChat Screenshots).pdf — the ten items as written, verbatim.
The deployed WeChat version added 'Name' and 'Student ID' ahead of these. Both are
DELIBERATELY OMITTED here: the participant code already ties the survey to the
conversation, so identity is never collected. Do not add them back.
Administering the survey inside the activity also fixes a defect in the original
study, where 146 survey responses could not be matched to 127 transcripts.
